tasks.title: Build drive-backup archiver + ledger seams (tar.zst snapshot, git diff, NDJSON ledger)
acceptance_criteria: tools/drive_backup/archiver.py and tools/drive_backup/ledger.py are NEW single-file, whole-file, stdlib-only modules.
archiver.DEFAULT_EXCLUDES is a frozenset containing node_modules, .venv, venv, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, *.pyc, state/output, _autowork_archive.
archiver.ArchiveResult exposes fields archive_path, diff_path, base_sha, manifest.
archiver.build_archive(repo_root, sha, *, runner, now, out_dir, exclude=DEFAULT_EXCLUDES, base_sha=None) -> ArchiveResult is the frozen signature.
Artifact stem is <repo_basename>_<sha[:7]>_<compactUTC> with .tar.zst and .diff siblings under out_dir.
runner is the ONLY subprocess seam; archive argv is a tar create piped/compressed to zstd and is recorded in the manifest.
exclude entries are materialized as --exclude args; .git is INCLUDED by default unless explicitly listed.
base_sha=None produces the empty-base full-diff form (git diff <sha>); otherwise git -C repo_root diff <base_sha>..<sha>.
manifest is JSON-able with keys repo, sha, base_sha, stem, excludes, archive_argv, diff_argv, created_at.
ledger.BackupLedger(path) takes an EXPLICIT path seam (no implicit default in tested surface).
BackupLedger.last_backed_up_sha() returns the most recent recorded sha or None when empty/missing.
BackupLedger.record(sha, archive_name, uploaded) appends a row atomically (write-temp-then-rename) and entries() round-trips rows in order.
Corrupt/partial trailing ledger lines are skipped, not fatal.
Neither module writes any archive/ledger/temp/lock/log into the repo or working tree; default destinations are never '.', os.getcwd(), or __file__'s dir; all file handles close deterministically.
python -m pytest tests/drive_backup/test_archiver.py tests/drive_backup/test_ledger.py -q is GREEN.

spec.objective: Create two NEW single-file, stdlib-only modules under tools/drive_backup/: archiver.py (build_archive producing a timestamped whole-tree tar.zst snapshot + a git diff against the last-backed-up commit, named by repo+sha7+compact UTC timestamp, caches excluded, with a manifest of dropped paths) and ledger.py (BackupLedger NDJSON record of prior backups). All subprocess access flows through the injected runner seam and all time through the injected now() seam — no real tar/zstd/git execution in any tested path. IMPL-only against the pre-committed RED oracles.
functional_requirements: archiver.DEFAULT_EXCLUDES is a frozenset containing the cache/dirs node_modules, .venv, venv, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache, *.pyc, state/output, _autowork_archive.
The artifact stem is <repo_basename>_<sha[:7]>_<now-as-compact-UTC-iso> (e.g. JanusMaskJR_a1b2c3d_20260612T231500Z), used for the .tar.zst and .diff siblings under out_dir.
The injected runner is the ONLY way subprocesses are touched, and the archive argv has a tar-create-then-zstd shape recorded as archive_argv in the manifest.
exclude entries are materialized as --exclude args in the archive argv, with .git INCLUDED by default (whole-dir honored) unless .git is explicitly listed in exclude.
When base_sha is None (first-ever backup) the diff uses the empty-base full-diff form (git diff <sha>, full vs empty tree); otherwise git -C repo_root diff <base_sha>..<sha>, recorded as diff_argv.

manifest is a JSON-able dict that is complete with keys repo, sha, base_sha, stem, excludes, archive_argv, diff_argv, created_at, and ArchiveResult carries archive_path, diff_path, base_sha, manifest.
BackupLedger.record(sha, archive_name, uploaded) followed by last_backed_up_sha() returns the most recent recorded sha and the row round-trips via entries() in order.
BackupLedger.last_backed_up_sha() returns None for an empty or missing ledger file.
spec.interfaces: tools/drive_backup/archiver.py: DEFAULT_EXCLUDES (frozenset); ArchiveResult dataclass{archive_path, diff_path, base_sha, manifest}; build_archive(repo_root, sha, *, runner, now, out_dir, exclude=DEFAULT_EXCLUDES, base_sha=None) -> ArchiveResult. tools/drive_backup/ledger.py: BackupLedger(path); last_backed_up_sha() -> str|None; record(sha, archive_name, uploaded: bool) -> None; entries() -> list[dict]. runner(argv, **kw) -> CompletedProcess-like is the injected subprocess seam; now() returns a tz-aware UTC datetime.
edge_cases: A corrupt or partial trailing line in the NDJSON ledger is SKIPPED, not fatal — entries() and last_backed_up_sha() still return the valid prior rows.
Recorded entries are DURABLE across separate BackupLedger instances pointed at the same path, proving the atomic write-temp-then-rename append.
non_goals: Integration wiring into the pre-push hook orchestration is OUT OF SCOPE here — deferred to the dependent drive-backup-hook-runner and drive-backup-installer leaves; this leaf only builds the archiver + ledger seams (no integration test gate is required).

No real tar, zstd, or git execution in any tested path — runner and now are injected seams; tests assert argv construction, naming, exclude materialization, manifest contents, and ledger round-trip only.
No upload logic (that is drive-backup-uploader) and no reading of git hook stdin (that is drive-backup-hook-runner).
No implicit ledger path default in the tested surface — BackupLedger(path) is an explicit seam.
No edits to any existing file (both modules are NEW) and no edits to any _NEVER_AUTO_APPROVE file; no third-party imports (stdlib only).
Does NOT author its own oracles — tests/drive_backup/test_archiver.py and tests/drive_backup/test_ledger.py are hand-authored RED preconditions and are authoritative if a pinned name differs.
spec.implementation_notes: BUILD-BLOCKING resource hygiene (prior run died auto_commit_failed_r1 because the staging worktree could not be removed): NEVER write archives, ledger DB/state, temp dirs, lock files, or logs into the repo/working tree — all output goes to a caller-supplied path or a tempfile.mkdtemp()/NamedTemporaryFile area OUTSIDE the repo, and default destinations MUST NOT be '.', os.getcwd(), or __file__'s dir. NEVER run git init/git clone or copy a tree containing a nested .git/ into the worktree. Close EVERY file handle deterministically (context managers or try/finally) — no module-global open handles and no leftover .lock/-wal/-shm sidecars — so the staging worktree removes with exit 0. The impl picks one tar|zstd pipeline shape (tar --use-compress-program=zstd or an explicit pipe) and records the chosen argv in manifest['archive_argv']. The committed RED oracles tests/drive_backup/test_archiver.py (7 tests) and tests/drive_backup/test_ledger.py (5 tests) are authoritative for pinned names.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: A fake runner capturing argv and **kw and returning a CompletedProcess-like stub; a fixed now() returning a tz-aware UTC datetime (e.g. 2026-06-12T23:15:00Z); a tmp_path out_dir and ledger path OUTSIDE the repo; sample sha/base_sha values and a synthetic NDJSON ledger with one corrupt/partial trailing line.

token_budget_ratio.note: Test tokens (160) >= 1.5x implementation tokens (100). Two small stdlib-only modules with a tight argv/naming/manifest surface and a ledger round-trip; the bulk of the proof load is in the paired RED oracles.
